item.title: CCC's Stress Relatively Well-Contained: Gomez-Bravo
item.description: Pilar Gomez-Bravo, fixed income portfolio manager at MFS Investment Management, and Andrzej Skiba, head of BlueBay US fixed income at RBC Global Asset Management join Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Real Yield." Junk bonds tied to data center developers traded weaker after elected Texas Democratic Governor Gina Hinojosa called for an immediate moratorium on development for the AI projects. (Source: Bloomberg)
